changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ratings ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, rental_id UUID NOT NULL, rater_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, rater_id UUID NOT NULL, target_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, target_id UUID NOT NULL, stars SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (stars BETWEEN 1 AND 5), comment TEXT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX idx_ratings_target ON ratings(target_type, target_id);
